scenes.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: landscape inline story painting for chapter 1 of “The Red Notebook”
Primary request: depict the end of paragraph 2: in the nearly closing library, Mika shows a plain red notebook to librarian Ms Sato; Ms Sato receives it and her smile fades as she notices something inside.
Input images: Image 1 is the approved simple inline style reference; Image 2 guides Mika's character identity and palette only.
Scene/backdrop: a quiet town library at a rainy October dusk, with one desk, a few shelves and a darkening rain-streaked window; a ceiling lamp is being switched off in the distance.
Subject: Mika is a dark-haired young woman in a muted teal cardigan over an ivory top, matching the cover's character identity and palette. She stands at one side of the desk, concerned. Ms Sato, a kind middle-aged librarian in simple understated clothes, sits at the desk and pauses with one hand near the open notebook. The notebook has a plain red cover; its pages are pale and show no visible marks.
Style/medium: gentle children's picture-book painting in the approved Kasa Jizō inline treatment: broad smooth colour areas, gentle contours, minimal texture, a few purposeful folds and shadows, quiet simplified background; distinctly simpler than the textured cover.
Composition/framing: medium-wide landscape about 12:7, both faces and the red notebook clearly readable as shapes, two or three broad depth layers, no cramped details.
Lighting/mood: warm library lamplight against cool rainy evening, quiet suspense without fear.
Color palette: warm ivory, midnight indigo, muted teal and restrained red.
Constraints: show only the librarian's first worried reaction from paragraph 2. No readable writing, letters, numbers, signs, captions, title, border, frame or watermark.
Avoid: supernatural effects, ominous horror, future events, readable notebook text, photorealism, glossy 3D, dense brush texture, cluttered shelves.

Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: landscape inline story painting for chapter 1 of the graded-reader “The Red Notebook”
Primary request: depict the end of paragraph 0: Mika is putting away books in the town library near closing time while her younger brother Ren reads beside the window and keeps glancing out at the road.
Reference guidance: no image files are attached to this generation. Describe the approved inline look as broad smooth colour areas, gentle contours, minimal surface texture, a few purposeful folds and shadows, two or three calm depth layers, and a quiet simplified background. The story cover informs Mika’s identity and palette only: dark hair tied back, muted teal cardigan and ivory top. Ren has dark hair and a simple navy top.
Scene/backdrop: a small town library at rainy October dusk, one wooden shelf and a rain-streaked window with a muted autumn tree and wet empty road beyond. A few books are being returned; keep the room uncluttered.
Subject: Mika calmly places a short stack of books on a low shelf. Ren sits near the window with a picture book open on his lap and glances toward the road, looking excited about tomorrow’s school trip without standing or leaving.
Style/medium: gentle hand-painted children’s picture-book art in the simple Kasa Jizō inline treatment, distinctly flatter and quieter than detailed cover art; smooth colour planes, soft edges, minimal marks, believable natural faces and hands.
Composition/framing: wide landscape about 12:7, both siblings readable in a medium-wide view, window and book shelf as simple framing shapes, two or three broad depth layers.
Lighting/mood: warm library lamp against cool rainy dusk; ordinary, expectant and peaceful.
Color palette: warm ivory, muted teal, midnight indigo, sage, soft wood ochre and restrained terracotta accents.
Constraints: show only paragraph 0. The road is empty; do not show a bus or any events from tomorrow. No red notebook, librarian, legible words, letters, numbers, signs, captions, title, border, frame or watermark.
Avoid: later plot events, supernatural effects, photorealism, glossy 3D, dense brush or surface texture, detailed clutter, dramatic suspense.
